title: IEANTN (Terence Tao): Explicit Chebyshev ψ/θ & Zero-Density Pipeline
description: Six verbatim open pipeline theorems from active and `awaiting-solution` nodes in Terence Tao's IEANTN (teorth/IEANTN@cd9c2dd3, Apache-2.0): BKLNW.v2 Table 8 tail deduction & Corollary 5.1 (ψ(x) - θ(x) explicit bound), Mossinghoff–Trudgian Corollary 1 (zero-free region to E_θ), Kadiri–Lumley–Ng zero-density estimate N(σ, T), and Fiori–Kadiri–Swidinsky (2023) explicit Chebyshev ψ bounds. Every upstream assumption is an explicit theorem hypothesis (0 custom axioms).

tasks.title: BKLNW.v2 (`awaiting-solution`): Table 8 unbounded tail from consecutive rows
tasks.description: Prove `BKLNW.v2.challenge_table8_psi_bound_above`: deduce the full-range Table 8 bound for e^b ≤ x ≤ e^25000 from `BKLNWNumerics.v1.table8_psi_bound` and monotonicity of Table 8.

tasks.title: BKLNW.v2 (`awaiting-solution`): Corollary 5.1 explicit ψ(x) - θ(x) bound
tasks.description: Prove `BKLNW.v2.challenge_corollary_5_1`: explicit bound on ψ(x) - θ(x) for 7 ≤ b ≤ 38 log 10 and x ≥ e^b given `Buthe.v1.theorem_2_theta_lower`.

tasks.title: Mossinghoff–Trudgian (2015) Corollary 1: zero-free region → E_θ classical bound
tasks.description: Prove `MT.v2.challenge_corollary_1`: convert `MT.v1.zero_free_region` into the explicit admissible classical bound on E_θ(x) for x ≥ 149.

tasks.title: Kadiri–Lumley–Ng (2018): explicit zero-density estimate N(σ, T)
tasks.description: Prove `KLN.v1.challenge_zero_density`: explicit N(σ, T) ≤ C₁ T^{8(1-σ)/3} (log T)^{5-2σ} + C₂ (log T)^2 for σ ∈ [0.75, 1) given `Platt2017.v1.rh_up_to`.

tasks.title: Fiori–Kadiri–Swidinsky (2023) Corollary 1.4: all-x explicit E_ψ(x) bound
tasks.description: Prove `FKS.v1.challenge_psi_bound_all_x`: E_ψ(x) < 9.22022 (log x)^{3/2} exp(-0.8476836 √(log x)) for all x > 2 from KLN, MT, and Platt–Trudgian hypotheses.

tasks.title: Fiori–Kadiri–Swidinsky (2023) Theorem 1.2: admissible classical E_ψ bound for x ≥ e^30
tasks.description: Prove `FKS.v1.challenge_psi_classical_bound`: `HasClassicalBound Eψ 121.096 (3/2) 2 5.5666305 (Real.exp 30)` from KLN, MT, and Platt–Trudgian hypotheses.
